visualRisks.description: Potential road or dock misalignment. The 'r' character, representing a road or dock, is isolated and may not align with expected patterns.
Isolated 'r' characters. These could represent roads or docks that are not properly connected to other elements in the district layout.

navigationRisks.description: Starting point of the route is at an unexpected location, which might confuse players and affect the overall flow of navigation.
The route has a sudden jump from column 42 to column 76, which could be disorienting for players navigating through the district.
